Worksheets are guided exercises that are meant to supplement lectures, and will be graded as part of your final mark in STAT545. Time will be given in lecture to work on these formative assessments.

Worksheets are produced with JupyterHub, which is linked directly on Canvas (no installation necessary).

**To work on your worksheet**:

-   Click the Worksheet Link on Canvas (under Assignments)

    ![](/webpages/lectures_i/images/worksheets_canvas.png)

-   Click "Load worksheet_a0X in a new window". This will load the worksheet into Jupyter and launch it in your browser!

    ![](/webpages/lectures_i/images/worksheet_launch.png)

-   Work on your worksheet. FIll in code cells where prompted, and run the test cells to see if you got the answer correct. A "Success!" message will appear if the answer is correct.

-   Save your work often.

-   When you are finished, restart your kernel, run all cells, ensure there are no errors and save your work. **Your work will automatically be submitted from this server and graded at the due date!** No submission to Canvas is necessary.

[**Worksheet Tips and Tricks:**]{.underline}

-   Only edit cells where prompted. If you accidentally click on a text-only cell, hit the play button and it should re-render.

-   You can check your answers prior to submitting! If you see a "Success!" message, you got the question right. Otherwise, a detailed error message will help you diagnose what went wrong.

-   Save your work frequently.

-   Prior to submitting, restart your kernel and run all to ensure that no errors persist. Save again.

-   We're here to help along the way on Slack, so don't be shy to ask for help if you need it.
